entity.name: Vinayak Raj Sharma
entity.description: Engineer working on GPS-denied autonomous UAV navigation and related embedded software. The project is intended to publish reusable navigation software and documentation for the open-source community as development and licensing are finalized.

projects.name: GPS-Denied UAV Navigation
projects.description: An intended open-source software project exploring navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles when GPS is unavailable or unreliable. Planned work includes software, integration notes, and documentation for sensor-based motion estimation and autonomous navigation. The repository, initial public release, and open-source license must be published before this manifest is submitted as a live project listing.
